name: Time Management
overview: Scripture teaches that time is a precious and limited gift from God, calling believers to recognize their frailty and the brevity of life as seen in Psalms 39:4 and Psalms 90:12. Wise time management involves trusting the Lord to direct our steps (Proverbs 16:9) and prioritizing His kingdom above all else (Matthew 6:33). Ecclesiastes 3:8 reminds us that there is a divinely appointed season for every activity, encouraging us to steward our time with discernment and purpose.
